proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destinationRestriction.keyed_plane_face
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation + charge-pool shape fits, but the surface cannot constrain a granted spell's destination to a cube face's keyed plane. Cubic Gate does not grant generic Gate or Plane Shift access; it grants item-mediated casts whose destination is fixed by the pressed side.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destinationRestriction.keyed_plane_face
proposed_widenings.justification: The same missing shape is pressured by the second spell mode as well. Plane Shift from the cube is not an unrestricted cast; it transports targets to the plane keyed to the chosen side.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

notes: Do not author this as plain grant_spell_access for Gate and Plane Shift. That would falsely imply normal destination selection instead of the item's face-keyed plane restriction. Charge pool, dawn recharge, legendary magic-item kind, and action activation all fit existing surface shapes.
